y-m-03-01.title: Umqolo ofanayo weBhotoni, Amaqela Ahlukileyo eeBhotoni Ezinkulu
y-m-03-01.topic: Imigangatho yokuhlela: ukumisela amagama anika isiphumo esifanayo kumntu wonke
y-m-03-01.goal: Qonda ukuba ukuhlela ngelizwi elinjenge 'kukhulu', elinomda ongacacanga, kunganika iziphumo ezahlukileyo kwabantu abahlukeneyo, uze wenze uze uchaze umgangatho onika isiphumo esifanayo nokuba ngubani ohlelayo.
y-m-03-01.material:
Iibhotoni ezi-8 zimi emqolweni omnye ukusuka kwezona zincinci ukuya kwezona zinkulu. Ukususela ekhohlo ziqanjwe ngokuthi 가, 나, 다, 라, 마, 바, 사, kunye no-아. Iibhotoni zonke zinombala nomo ofanayo kwaye zahlukile kubukhulu kuphela.
UMina uqokelele 라, 마, 바, 사, kunye no-아 (iibhotoni ezi-5) njengee'bhotoni ezinkulu'. UHajun uqokelele 마, 바, 사, kunye no-아 (iibhotoni ezi-4) njengee'bhotoni ezinkulu'. Bobabini bajonge umqolo ofanayo weebhotoni, kwaye bobabini bahlela ngelizwi elithi 'ibhotoni enkulu'.
y-m-03-01.thinking.1: Gweba ukuba kufuneka ntoni enye ukuze kufumaneke isiphumo esifanayo
y-m-03-01.s.s1.prompt: Sesiphi esona sizathu sifanelekileyo sokuba iibhotoni ezinkulu eziqokelelwe ngabantu ababini zahlukile?
y-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala macala ngamacala iibhotoni ezinkulu eziqokelelwe ngabantu ababini uze ufumane ukuba zeziphi iibhotoni ezahlukileyo.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cinga ukuba ngaba ubeka leyo bhotoni phakathi kwee'bhotoni ezinkulu' okanye hayi, kwaye ukuba nguwe omisela, wawuya kujonga ntoni ukumisela.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.a: UMina unamehlo abhetele kunoHajun, ngoko ukuqokelela kukaMina kuchanekile ngakumbi
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.a: Ukubone njengemeko yamehlo amahle okanye amabi. Bobabini bajonge umqolo ofanayo baza baqokelela besebenzisa ilizwi elithi 'enkulu', ngoko umahluko ibisisithuba somgca welizwi.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.b: Babale ngokungalunganga, ngoko ukuba babala kwakhona iziphumo zabantu ababini ziya kufana
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.b: Ukubone njengempazamo yokubala. Umahluko phakathi kwe-5 ne-4 usenokuba ngenxa yempazamo yokubala, kodwa usenokuba ngenxa yokuba bahluka ekubeni baqale phi ukuyibiza ibhotoni 'ibhotoni enkulu'.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.c: UHajun akayazi intsingiselo ye'nkulu', ngoko nguHajun kuphela ongalunganga kwaye uMina ulungile
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.c: Ukubone njengomntu omnye kuphela ongalunganga. Bobabini baqokelele ngokungaguquki ngokwemigangatho yabo.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.o.d: Ayimiselwanga ngelizwi lodwa ukuba 'enkulu' iqala kweyiphi ibhotoni, ngoko bazobe umgca ngokwahlukeneyo
y-m-03-01.s.s1.r.d: Uphendule ingqalelo yakho kwindawo apho ilizwi 'enkulu' lihlula khona. Oku kukucinga okuvavanye umda welizwi elisebenza njengomgangatho.
y-m-03-01.s.s1.explain: Ngelizwi elinje ngelithi 'enkulu' kuphela, apho abantu banokuzoba umgca ngokwahlukeneyo, kunzima ukufumana isiphumo esifanayo. UMina wabona iibhotoni ukususela ku-라 njengee'bhotoni ezinkulu', kwaye uHajun wabona iibhotoni ukususela ku-마 njengee'nkulu'. Bobabini bahlela ngokungaguquki ngokwemigangatho yabo.

y-m-03-01.s.s2.hint.0: Khomba kwakhona apho uMina noHajun bahlela ngokwahlukeneyo.

y-m-03-01.s.s2.o.a: Yenza aba bantu babini bamisele ngendlela efanayo ukuba yeyiphi ibhotoni abaza kuyibala 'njengebhotoni enkulu' ukususela kuyo

y-m-03-01.s.s2.r.d: Ucinge ngocwangciso lokuhlela. Ukuba uhlela ulandela, ukopa nje umgca womntu omnye, kwaye umgangatho awumiselwanga.

y-m-03-08.s.s2.r.d: Wenze amava angekho kwitheyibhile. Itheyibhile ixela kuphela iindawo abafuna ukuya kuzo.
y-m-03-08.s.s2.explain: Itheyibhile ixela kuphela 'bangaphi abafundi abakhethe indawo ephi'. Isixa singabafundi abali-12, ngoko bonke bakhethe enye yeendawo ezintathu, kwaye ungathi nokuba iziko lezilwanyana linabantu abaninzi kunemyuziyam. Ukonwaba okanye amava awanakwaziwa kwitheyibhile.
